observations.body: The song opens with willing leaders and people, then pictures the LORD marching from Seir as earth and mountains quake, naming Sinai before Israel’s God.
observations.label: Deborah’s song recalls Sinai’s quaking presence

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.

payload.posture: Read Judges 5:1–5 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Deborah’s song recalls Sinai’s quaking presence belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
